registry: Exact v0.3/v0.4 64-outcome registry and 20 proxy-only policies.

shared_audit.allocation: equal over 2 sampled moments times 16 checkpoints
shared_audit.monotone_envelope: running minimum of valid upper bounds

movement_ordered_partial_census.order: descending absolute policy displacement |pi_i-p0_i| with labelled-index tie break
movement_ordered_partial_census.unseen_bound: minus sum_unseen |pi_i-p0_i| under the unit error cap
movement_ordered_partial_census.crossing: first distinct audited atom giving strictly positive lower true-gain margin

gates.G0_registration_binding: All sources, protocol, parent tables, tests, and verifier are committed and hash-bound before execution.
gates.G1_empirical_bernstein_instrument: For each error population, the 95% exact binomial upper bound on streams with any simultaneous empirical-Bernstein norm failure is at most 0.07.
gates.G2_conditional_soundness: Neither empirical Bernstein nor movement-ordered partial census has a positive crossing for a non-positive-true-gain policy when its instrument is valid.
gates.G3_monotone_dynamics: All empirical-Bernstein and partial-census certificate paths are nondecreasing and have zero reversions.
gates.G4_partial_census_exactness: At 64 audited atoms, the partial-census lower margin equals exact true gain for every policy/error cell.
gates.G5_top_spike_efficiency_order: For every diffuse top-spike policy, movement-ordered partial census crosses before the empirical-Bernstein median, which crosses before the frozen Hoeffding minimum.
gates.G6_complete_threshold_reporting: Every method reports a crossing or explicit censoring class for every policy/error cell; no crossing-fraction gate is used.
gates.G7_resources_and_receipts: The run stays under CPU/RAM ceilings and emits write-once tables, figure, report, and receipts.

decision_rule.ordering_not_established: G0 through G4, G6, and G7 pass but G5 fails
decision_rule.not_established: G1, G2, G3, G4, or G6 fails

claim_boundary: Synthetic 64-outcome audit-efficiency comparison; movement-ordered census assumes enumerable atoms and no learned reward model or ASMP-8 resolution.
